prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1465; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute pain in the left shoulder. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force and direction of the crash, and the presenting complaint fits well with that history. No prior injury to the same shoulder is known from the records available to this clinic. Over the course of 18 visits, care included physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication, following a typical and expected progression. Symptoms gradually improved and visit frequency was tapered as the patient's function returned. Imaging of the shoulder was unremarkable, and orthopedic examination maneuvers were negative. Most of the reported symptoms and functional limitations are based on the patient's own description of pain, as no objective abnormality was identified on testing. Billing records reflect single charges for each service with no duplicate entries.
